lines.speaker: Voice
lines.text: The money came through. Same as before.

lines.speaker: Doyle
lines.text: She always wants it quiet. I've learned that much.

lines.speaker: Voice
lines.text: There's a detective asking questions about the manor.

lines.speaker: Doyle
lines.text: Could be a problem. For her — and for us.

lines.speaker: Doyle
lines.text: The arrangement was one job. Now she wants permanent silence on top of it.

lines.speaker: Voice
lines.text: Then perhaps we renegotiate the terms.

spotted_message: They have spotted you. Doyle is reaching for something.
